BeginApplicationSetupTipTextBlock.Text: Don't know where to start? Not a problem! Visit following resources to learn more about this application
ByeDPIModeHelpTextBlock.Text:
This group will only be active if one of the events from the previous one has occurred.
Possible events:
     torst: Timeout or server reset connection after first request
     redirect: HTTP Redirect with Location whose domain does not match the outgoing one
     ssl_err: No ServerHello was received in response to ClientHello or the SH contains an invalid session_id
     none : The previous group was skipped, for example due to domain or protocol restrictions
CheckAdGuard: AdGuard services may cause problems via Discord or another services
CheckAnotherComponents: In one time only one bypass service (Zapret, GoodbyeDPI) may be enable. Two or more services may cause problems like downgrading Network speed or lost connection to Network
CheckAnotherComponentsServices: In one time only one bypass service (Zapret, GoodbyeDPI) may be enable. Two or more services may cause problems like downgrading Network speed or lost connection to Network
CheckBFE: Base Filtering Engine (BFE) is required to work with traffic for some components (Zapret, for example). If this service stopped component can't work normally.
CheckCheckPointServices: "CheckPoint" service conflicts with components like zapret. It's must be disabled in system
CheckDNS: Make sure you have configured secure DNS in a browser with some non-default DNS service provider
CheckIntelConnectivityNetwork: "Intel Connectivity Network" service conflicts with components like zapret. It's must be disabled in system
CheckKiller: "Killer" services conflicts with components like zapret. It's must be disabled in system
CheckNetsh: Utility "netsh.exe" must exist in system PATH variable. Without that file component's cannot work normally.
CheckProxy: To use components like Zapret or GoodbyeDPI you must disable system proxy. (It's not applied to local proxy, who not applied for all system)
CheckSmartByte: "SmartByte" service conflicts with components like zapret. It's must be disabled in system
CheckTimestamps: TCP timestamps is required to normal components work
CheckVPNs: All VPNs services are conflicts with components. Make sure it's disabled or removed from system
CheckWinDivert: "WinDivert" must be stopped during diagnostic. If it still running make sure you removed all previous services

CheckGitHubRepo:
Store uses GitHub repository to get list of available for download items and check updates. If repository on GitHub is unavailable (for example: internet provider blocked service), select another service in Store settings.

To view more info about fixing this problem, visit attached link.
CheckGitLabRepo:
Store uses GitLab repository to get list of available for download items and check updates. If repository on GitLab is unavailable (for example: internet provider blocked service), select another service in Store settings.

To view more info about fixing this problem, visit attached link.
CheckWriteAccess: Application uses your disk to save your items and settings. If application don't have a permissions for that, some things may not work.

Tip_1: Application has automatic troubleshooting utility! It may help you if some things not work – Store cannot install items, component won't run and more. Just visit [Utilities] page and find [Troubleshooting utility]
Tip_2: You can change default mono font, who shown in [Pseudoconsole] and other places in [View] settings. You also can setup path view mode – full or only names (it make output more readable and hiding you real username)
Tip_4: I'm always with you! Only when you use this application actually. But does you need be close to be close?
Tip_5:
If you installed ByeDPI, NoDPI or SpoofDPI you need to setup proxy. Without that component take no effect on you traffic. 
For setup proxy visit [Utilities] page and find [Setup proxy].

Tip_9:
Changing hosts file may help you get access to Finland Discord servers and GitHub storage. 
U can change hosts file using [Hosts file changing utility]. Just find it on [Utilities] page.

Tip_11:
There is no need to select config manually! 
Just go to [Autoselection] utility, select component you want and make some tea (or coffee, what u like more). Find it at [Utilities] page.
Tip_12:
If you don't like something in this app, there is two ways for you:
1. Tell about it developer and wait some time (it maybe reeeeealy long time).
2. Just do it! Clone the repo, make changes and create pull request. There is 90% chance you code will be approved.

Tip_14: You can edit config kit by yourself and share it with friends! Just visit [Config Maker] and select [Edit Config Kit].
YouMustGetConfigsFirstTextBlock.Text: Component – it's only engine, who helps with work on traffic. To use component you must get configuration for you provider – different configurations works with different providers
